### The Glory of Solomon
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/glory-of-solomon
Passage: 1 Kings 4:21
Points:
- Solomon's reign over a vast, populous kingdom marked a major fulfillment of God's covenant promises to Abraham.
- The peace, security, and expansive territorial borders realized the inheritance pledged centuries earlier in Genesis.
- Solomon's accumulation of thousands of chariot horses revealed the flaws and limitations of his earthly kingship.
- The ultimate and perfect consummation of God's promises arrives only through Jesus Christ and the growth of His church.
